freshnessRules.planillas: Request the current version only when a specific reconciliation requires it. Do not use an older previously supplied version after the user reports that it has changed.
freshnessRules.bankStatements: Request a current statement only for a specific unresolved HOLD. Do not use prior statements as current balance authority.
freshnessRules.financialFiles: Request the current file only in its own financial-history block. Never use it as payment or bank evidence.
freshnessRules.portfolioSnapshots: Older snapshots remain valid historical evidence for their own cutoff but are not current-balance authority.
freshnessRules.postCutoffPayments: A payment after the portfolio snapshot cutoff is valid and can explain an obligation that was pending at the earlier cutoff.

sources.rule: Requires corroboration and authorization; never auto-applies.
Direct insurer evidence, still matched one-to-one and never auto-applied.
Presence proves pending at cutoff. Disappearance from a later comparable complete snapshot is clearing evidence but does not create a cobro alone.
A recognized or paid commission corroborates collection; timing differences and data-contract conflicts remain visible. Commission alone does not create a cobro.
Request only when a specific HOLD needs corroboration. Bank alone does not create a cobro.
Never substitutes for a payment report, portfolio statement, commission plan, or bank statement.

nextUserInputWhenRequested: Ask only for the current version of a planilla, bank statement, or financial file when a specific unresolved reconciliation requires it.
Do not ask again for a source already registered with the same hash.
Do not infer an insurer identity from an ambiguous filename or workbook.
